spec2def(pstorec.dll pstorec.spec)

add_idl_reg_objects(pstorec regtypelib pstorec_tlb.idl)
 # CORE-5743: No CONST_VTABLE

# pstorec.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/pstorec-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(pstorec_shims OBJECT pstorec.c)
target_link_libraries(pstorec_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(pstorec_shims)
add_dependencies(pstorec_shims stdole2)
set(PSTOREC_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/pstorec/pstorec_tlb_t.o)
add_cargo_module(pstorec pstorec-cargo pstorec.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS pstorec_shims pstorec_t ${PSTOREC_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
